update.title: RISC-V: Describe relax passes with a pass table
update.body:
_bfd_riscv_relax_section picks the relax function for each reloc with a
chain of branches on info->relax_pass, and ld hard-codes the number of
passes.  Adding a pass means adding another branch and bumping the
count in the emulation.

This is a refactor to make room for more relax passes, such as
vendor specific ones or one for Zcmt table jump.  Each such pass would
otherwise add its own branch, its own gating check run for every
section, and its own special case for cleanup.

Describe each pass with a riscv_relax_pass: a reloc selector, an
optional per-section finish hook, an optional end-of-pass hook, and
whether it runs when target specific optimizations are disabled.
bfd_elfNN_riscv_init_relax_passes builds the pass list for a link, and
ld stores the count in link_info.relax_pass.  The passes are the same
as before, so there is no change in output.

bfd/ChangeLog:

	* elfnn-riscv.c (RISCV_MAX_RELAX_PASSES): New.
	(struct riscv_elf_link_hash_table): Add relax_passes,
	num_relax_passes and cur_relax_pass.
	(riscv_elf_link_hash_table_free): Finish the last relax pass.
	(riscv_elf_link_hash_table_create): Init cur_relax_pass.
	(riscv_relax_pass): New.
	(riscv_relax_skip_paired_relax, riscv_relax_select_shorten)
	(riscv_relax_select_align, riscv_add_relax_pass)
	(riscv_finish_relax_pass, bfd_elfNN_riscv_init_relax_passes): New.
	(_bfd_riscv_relax_section): Use the pass table.
	* elfxx-riscv.h (bfd_elf32_riscv_init_relax_passes)
	(bfd_elf64_riscv_init_relax_passes): Declare.

ld/ChangeLog:

	* emultempl/riscvelf.em (riscv_elf_before_allocation): Get
	the number of relax passes from BFD.
update.author: kito-cheng

items.impact_zh: 主要影响上游 RISC-V 链接器的代码结构和可维护性，为后续 vendor-specific 或 Zcmt table jump 等新 relax pass 提供扩展点；据提交描述当前不改变链接输出。局限：仅依据上游元数据判断，不能确认该变更已经构建、测试或已进入 RuyiSDK 工具链，实际影响需在目标版本中人工核对。

update.title: RISC-V: Enable shared library and PIE support for riscv*-elf
update.body:
riscv*-elf is the only RISC-V target for which ld refuses -shared and
-pie.  elf32lriscv-defs.sh has withheld GENERATE_SHLIB_SCRIPT and
GENERATE_PIE_SCRIPT from it since be1dce26256a ("RISC-V: Disable shared
library support for embedded elf."), whose commit message is a ChangeLog
entry and records no reason.  Nothing in the RISC-V backend depends on
the exclusion, and riscv*-elf does not even set EMBEDDED.

Other bare-metal ELF targets do generate the scripts.  aarch64*-elf was
given PIE support deliberately, in 3af09e8db308 ("Support -pie for
aarch64*-elf targets."), and arm-elf and x86_64-elf have both.  The
general question was raised in f2aaebdb9797 ("GENERATE_SHLIB_SCRIPT vs.
EMBEDDED.") and settled the other way: that patch was reverted in
8a46e447a88d, the author concluding that the ELF and program headers are
still written to the file, so an embedded ELF target producing an ET_DYN
image is not the mistake he had taken it for.

ld/
	* emulparams/elf32lriscv-defs.sh (GENERATE_SHLIB_SCRIPT): Set
	unconditionally rather than only for non-riscv*-elf targets.
	(GENERATE_PIE_SCRIPT): Likewise.

Assisted-by: Claude:claude-opus-5
Signed-off-by: Mintsuki <mintsuki@protonmail.com>
update.author: Mintsuki

items.summary_zh: 上游 binutils-gdb 已合入提交：修改 ld/emulparams/elf32lriscv-defs.sh，使 riscv*-elf 目标也生成共享库脚本和 PIE 脚本，从而允许 ld 接受 -shared 与 -pie；此前该目标被排除在外，本次变更与 aarch64*-elf、arm-elf 等裸机 ELF 目标的做法对齐。
items.impact_zh: 对 riscv*-elf 裸机/嵌入式工具链而言，链接器能力发生变化，可生成 ET_DYN 的共享对象或 PIE 镜像，可能属于功能增强，也可能影响原有嵌入式链接行为。局限：仅依据上游提交，不能确认在 RuyiSDK 工具链中已合入、构建或测试通过，需人工验证实际支持情况。
items.packaging_advice_zh: 需人工核实所用 binutils 版本或分支是否包含该提交，并检查 RuyiSDK 对 riscv*-elf 工具链的定位；建议回归 -shared、-pie 及常规静态链接场景，确认链接脚本生成和 ELF 头符合预期；若面向嵌入式场景，应评估 ET_DYN 镜像是否会被误用或与引导/烧写流程冲突，不能仅凭上游提交即认为已受支持。
